title: Sagan's early diaries about UFOs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sagan's early diaries about UFOs, about 1950s-1960s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in his early diaries. He'd write about UFOs all the time.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Carl Sagan, a famous American astronomer later known as a sceptic, wrote about UFOs all the time in his early diaries. According to Michels this was in the 1950s and 60s. It would suggest that Sagan took the subject more seriously in private than his public image showed.
